theme_and_archetype.name: Archetype 1 / Soft Utility Hybrid (Light Theme)
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: For a friendly B2B Irish fleet management tool, we want to move away from cold, sterile 'tech bro' design (dark greys, sharp corners, pure white) and towards a warm, approachable, reliable partner vibe. Soft radii, warm slate neutrals, and premium diffuse shadows achieve this.

critique: 1. Cold color palette: The use of pure white 'bg-white' and 'bg-grey-50' with harsh text colors feels sterile and template-like.
2. Lack of hierarchy: The 6-icon grid provides no hierarchy. Everything is equal, meaning nothing stands out.
3. Passive engagement: The screenshot carousel is passive and disconnected from feature benefits.
4. Boxy elements: Small border radii ('rounded-lg', 'rounded-xl') and standard drop shadows feel dated and heavy.

colors.background: Use 'bg-slate-50' for main sections instead of harsh white or cold grey.
colors.primary: Keep brand 'blue-600' for active states. Introduce 'blue-50' for soft highlight backgrounds behind icons.
colors.accents: Keep 'cyan-400' but use sparingly. Introduce 'emerald-50/600' and 'amber-50/600' for status/bento card accents.

typography.headings: font-sans tracking-tight text-slate-900 (The tight tracking removes the generic feel).

shapes_and_shadows.border_radius: Use 'rounded-2xl' and 'rounded-3xl' for a friendlier, softer feel.
shapes_and_shadows.shadows: Use 'shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]' (soft, ambient premium shadow) instead of harsh default shadows.
shapes_and_shadows.borders: Use 'border border-slate-200/60' for delicate card edges.

features_section.new_layout: Asymmetric Bento Box Grid (Condensed but warm)
features_section.structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto pt-10
features_section.heading: Visible section header: 'Everything you need to run your fleet, without the headache.' - text-center text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 mb-12

items.name: Smart Booking
items.styling: bg-white p-8 md:p-10 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/60 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden group hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between h-full
items.content: Large text-2xl font-bold heading, text-slate-600 body. Icon: Calendar in a bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-2xl p-4 w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center. Focus on preventing double-bookings. Suggest adding a pure CSS mini-visual (like 2 overlapping pill tags: 'Booked - Transit' and 'Available').

items.name: Compliance Tracking
items.styling: bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/60 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-6 hover:shadow-md transition-all
items.content: Icon: Shield in bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600. Focus on Tax, NCT, Insurance. Add a mock 'Status: Valid' green pill badge next to the title.

items.name: Real-Time Updates
items.styling: bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/60 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-6 hover:shadow-md transition-all
items.content: Icon: Clock in bg-amber-50 text-amber-600. Focus on instant notifications and live data.

items.name: The Essentials (Fleet, Staff, Reports)
items.styling: bg-slate-900 p-8 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-lg flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-6
items.content: Dark high-contrast banner strip at the bottom of the bento. Contains 3 inline mini-features with Lucide icons (Car, Users, BarChart3) styled as 'flex items-center gap-3 text-white/90 font-medium'. Text: 'Plus all the essentials: Fleet Tracking, Staff Roles, and Analytics.' Add a 'Request Demo' arrow CTA button.

see_in_action_section.structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto items-center mt-10
see_in_action_section.heading: Text: 'See Quick Wing in action' - text-center text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 mb-12

left_column.items: 3 clickable tab cards. Each represents a screenshot state.
left_column.active_tab_styling: text-left bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.06)] transition-all ring-1 ring-slate-900/5 cursor-default
left_column.inactive_tab_styling: text-left p-6 rounded-3xl border border-transparent opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-slate-200/50 cursor-pointer transition-all
left_column.content_details: Inside each tab: Title (text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900) + brief 2-line description (text-slate-600). Add a small colored dot or indicator to show the active state.

right_column.styling: relative aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-white border border-slate-200/60 shadow-2xl group
right_column.browser_frame: Top bar: 'h-12 bg-slate-100 flex items-center px-4 gap-2 border-b border-slate-200/60'. Add 3 dots (red, yellow, green) simulating a macOS window to make it feel like a polished app.
right_column.image_handling: Render the image corresponding to the active tab. Use 'absolute inset-0 top-12 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-500 ease-in-out' to fade between images. Active image gets 'opacity-100 z-10', inactive gets 'opacity-0 z-0'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace the existing generic 6-item 'features' grid with the asymmetrical Bento Grid layout detailed in this guideline.
Completely rewrite the 'ScreenshotCarousel' component into a new interactive 'ProductShowcase' component using the Tabbed approach, mapping to the 3 provided images.
Update the overall page background ('bg-white' -> 'bg-slate-50') and increase section padding ('py-12' -> 'py-20' or 'py-24') to give elements room to breathe.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='feature-tab-0').
Do NOT use external animation libraries like Framer Motion. Rely strictly on Tailwind CSS transitions ('transition-all duration-300 opacity-0 opacity-100' etc.).
Correct the British/Irish spelling 'grey' in Tailwind classes if they were typos causing fallbacks. Always use standard 'slate' (e.g., 'text-slate-900', 'bg-slate-50', 'border-slate-200').
Ensure the ROI Calculator and existing Hero section remain functional but adapt them to the new softer aesthetic where applicable (like removing harsh pure white backgrounds).
